description: Catalog definition for the @a2ui/react renderer (packages/a2ui-react/src/components). It describes exactly the atomic components the React renderer implements: Text, Row, Column, List, Button, TextField. MountFade is an internal entrance-animation wrapper (application/json+a2ui is not a protocol component) and is intentionally excluded. Component schemas are derived from standard_catalog_definition.json, restricted to this supported subset.

text.description: The text content to display. This can be a literal string or a reference to a value in the data model ('path', e.g., '/doc/title'). While simple Markdown formatting is supported (i.e. without HTML, images, or links), utilizing dedicated UI components is generally preferred for a richer and more structured presentation.

usageHint.description:
A hint for the base text style. One of:
- `h1`: Largest heading.
- `h2`: Second largest heading.
- `h3`: Third largest heading.
- `h4`: Fourth largest heading.
- `h5`: Fifth largest heading.
- `caption`: Small text for captions.
- `body`: Standard body text.

children.description: Defines the children. Use 'explicitList' for a fixed set of children, or 'template' to generate children from a data list.

template.description: A template for generating a dynamic list of children from a data model list. `componentId` is the component to use as a template, and `dataBinding` is the path to the map of components in the data model. Values in the map will define the list of children.

distribution.description: Defines the arrangement of children along the main axis (horizontally). This corresponds to the CSS 'justify-content' property.

alignment.description: Defines the alignment of children along the cross axis (vertically). This corresponds to the CSS 'align-items' property.

children.description: Defines the children. Use 'explicitList' for a fixed set of children, or 'template' to generate children from a data list.

template.description: A template for generating a dynamic list of children from a data model list. `componentId` is the component to use as a template, and `dataBinding` is the path to the map of components in the data model. Values in the map will define the list of children.

distribution.description: Defines the arrangement of children along the main axis (vertically). This corresponds to the CSS 'justify-content' property.

alignment.description: Defines the alignment of children along the cross axis (horizontally). This corresponds to the CSS 'align-items' property.

children.description: Defines the children. Use 'explicitList' for a fixed set of children, or 'template' to generate children from a data list. With 'template', the renderer iterates the array (by index) or map (by key) at `dataBinding`, renders `componentId` once per item, and bindings inside the template are resolved relative to the current item.

template.description: A template for generating a dynamic list of children from a data model list. `componentId` is the component to use as a template, and `dataBinding` is the path to the list or map in the data model. Each value defines one child, and relative bindings inside the template resolve against that item.

direction.description: The direction in which the list items are laid out. Defaults to 'vertical'.

alignment.description: Defines the alignment of children along the cross axis.

child.description: The ID of the component to display in the button, typically a Text component.

primary.description: Indicates if this button should be styled as the primary action.

action.description: The client-side action to be dispatched when the button is clicked. It includes the action's name and an optional context payload.

value.description: Defines the value to be included in the context as either a literal value or a path to a data model value (e.g. '/user/name').

localUpdate.description: A2UI 0.8 extension for client-local interaction. When `localUpdate` is present, the action is a LOCAL update instead of a server round-trip: no `userAction` is dispatched. On trigger, the client resolves `value` (a literal string/number/boolean or a `path` reference) and applies it as a simulated `dataModelUpdate` at `path` within the current surface, then re-renders. Use this for purely local state changes (e.g., a button toggling a line of text).

path.description: The data model path to write, relative to the surface root (e.g., '/message').

value.description: The value to write, resolved at trigger time: a literal (literalString / literalNumber / literalBoolean) or a reference to another data model value ('path').

label.description: The text label for the input field. This can be a literal string or a reference to a value in the data model ('path', e.g. '/user/name').

text.description: The value of the text field. This can be a literal string or a reference to a value in the data model ('path', e.g. '/user/name'). Only a 'path' binding is writable; edits are committed back to that path.

textFieldType.description: The type of input field to display: 'obscured' renders a password input, 'longText' a multi-line textarea, 'number' and 'date' use the corresponding native inputs.

validationRegexp.description: A regular expression used for client-side validation of the input.

font.description: The primary font for the UI.

primaryColor.description: The primary UI color as a hexadecimal code (e.g., '#00BFFF').
